title: Sushi Rice Bowl with French Mini Pilaf
description: A fusion dish combining sushi rice with a flavorful French-inspired mini pilaf, perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat the cooked sushi rice over low heat.
Combine the cooked pilaf with the sushi rice and stir to combine.
Add the cooked onion and bell pepper mixture to the rice and pilaf mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the sushi rice bowl hot, garnished with additional sliced bell peppers if desired.
